description: Defines the inter_slice_scheduler class responsible for inter-slice scheduling in a radio network, including slice management, candidate selection, and resource allocation.

classes.name: inter_slice_scheduler
classes.description: Main class managing inter-slice scheduling, resource allocation, and candidate selection.

classes.name: ran_slice_sched_context
classes.description: Tracks scheduling context for each RAN slice instance, including priority determination.

classes.name: slice_candidate_context
classes.description: Represents a candidate slice with priority, RB limits, and transmission slot.

classes.name: slice_prio_queue
classes.description: Priority queue managing slice candidates based on their priority.

classes.name: slot_context
classes.description: Holds information about PUSCH time domain resources for a slot.

methods.name: inter_slice_scheduler
methods.description: Constructor initializing scheduler with cell configuration and UE repository.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Resets slice states based on slot indication.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a UE to the scheduler.

methods.name: config_applied
methods.description: Marks configuration as applied for a UE.

methods.name: get_next_dl_candidate
methods.description: Retrieves the next downlink slice candidate.

methods.name: get_next_ul_candidate
methods.description: Retrieves the next uplink slice candidate.

methods.name: slice_config
methods.description: Returns configuration of a specific slice.

methods.name: get_policy
methods.description: Returns the scheduling policy for a slice.

methods.name: get_nof_used_reserved_rbs
methods.description: Calculates total reserved RBs for a slot.

methods.name: get_slice
methods.description: Fetches a slice instance based on logical channel configuration.

methods.name: fetch_ue_to_update
methods.description: Fetches a UE for update or reconfiguration.

methods.name: add_impl
methods.description: Implementation detail for adding a UE.

methods.name: get_next_candidate
methods.description: Template method to get next candidate for UL or DL.
